# NON_CANONICAL / DEVELOPMENT_ONLY: reach_window

This fixture exercises constrained reach; it is not registered in tendon_v1.
All dimensions are development choices, with no benchmark or optimization approval.
EnvironmentSpec is the sole geometry source. `mujoco.xml` is generated by
`tools.spec_tools.environment_xml` and checked by the existing package validator.
MATLAB receives the same four frame bars via `window_boxes`; it defines no environment.

World origin is the fixed robot base, +x is straight forward, y-z the cross section.
The rectangular aperture is normal to +x with finite frame width and wall thickness.
Only one axis-aligned window is currently supported. The development evaluator
requires final target error within tolerance, full final arm crossing through the
aperture slab with body-radius margin, and no sampled window contact during execution.
The initial arm may already cross the window: this is constrained final-shape reach,
not a certified insertion maneuver from an initially retracted arm. Floor contact
is excluded from the window constraint, consistent with the existing supported floor.

Human input required before registering a frozen benchmark: target, tolerance,
window centre and orientation, aperture width/height, wall thickness and finite wall
extent (frame width), coordinate convention, and acceptance of these crossing/contact
semantics and initial configuration. Other planes/orientations need implementation.

Run using `python examples/run_reach_pipeline.py --task-package tests/fixtures/reach_window_dev`.
